title: Canonical additive comparison on each open
statement: For a scheme $X$ [def-pc-scheme], an $\mathcal O_X$-module $F$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and a functor $i:X.Opens\to X.Etale$ with $i$ followed by forgetting to $Over(X)$ equal to the open restriction functor, define $e_U:\Gamma(i(U),i(U)^*F)\xrightarrow{\sim}F(U)$ [lem-sc-etale-qcoherent-presheaf-functorial], [def-sc-module-cech-comparison]. First transport along the equality of over-scheme objects. Then evaluate the canonical comparison of tensor pullback [def-pc-module-pullback] and restriction, both left adjoint to the same pushforward [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction], [lem-weil-pbc-open-immersion-module-pullback-restriction], at the whole open subscheme. Finally identify its image with $U$.

proof.text: Evaluate the leftAdjointUniq isomorphism from the canonical tensor adjunction to restrictAdjunction on F and then on top sections; compose restrictAppIso and the image-top transport. Transport the source along hi. All maps and their inverses are explicitly constructed.
